content.text:
**Finding: missing** (medium severity) — no post-termination transition assistance or customer data return.

- Section 17 handles exit only in Garman's favour: Sparkling must cease use and certify destruction/return of the Software, Documentation and Codes. Nothing requires Garman to assist with migration or to return Sparkling's own data (which Garman handles under the Section 4 data conversion work), and nothing addresses deletion or certification.
- Section 8 return-of-Confidential-Information is limited to the reject-option scenario; Section 18 survival adds no exit-assistance hook. Searches for "transition" and "return" confirm no equivalent clause elsewhere.
- Because the agreement falls short of even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export), I proposed a new Section 17(d) at the preferred position — six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, certified deletion thereafter — with the 90-day fallback offered in the comment. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
